court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
case_name: Sou Kanchan Atulaman Mishra @ Kanchan ... vs Shri. Atulaman Shubhsudan Mishra

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: SOU KANCHAN ATULAMAN MISHRA @ KANCHAN AMIRITNARAYAN MISHRA (husband)

facts_of_case: Parties got married on 17/04/2014 and are blessed with a daughter aged about seven years. Applicant has initiated criminal proceedings against the non-applicant for the offence punishable under Sections 498-A, 406, 323, 504, 506 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code. Wife sought transfer of proceedings being Marriage Petition No. 318 of 2018 initiated under Section 13(1) of the Hindu Marriage Act for divorce.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the applicant to establish hardship.
legal_principles.held: Though served, none appears for the non-applicant. As such, contentions raised in the Application under Section 24 of the Civil Procedure Code are not controverted.

legal_principles.principle: A transfer of proceedings can be granted on the ground of hardship.
legal_principles.held: In the aforesaid backdrop, on the ground of hardship, Applicant-wife has sought transfer of proceedings being Marriage Petition No. 318 of 2018 initiated under Section 13(1) of the Hindu Marriage Act for divorce...

outcome.final_order: Marriage Petition No. 318 of 2018 pending before the Hon'ble Civil Judge Senior Division at Vasai to be transferred to the Learned Civil Judge Senior Division, Kalyan.
